main.title: Dying Light 2 Stay Human
main.summary: Dying Light 2 Stay Human is a 2022 action role-playing survival horror game developed and published by Techland.

cards.heading: Surviving after the fall
cards.text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human is a 2022 action role-playing survival horror game developed and published by Techland. The game is a sequel to Dying Light, and was released for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on February 4, 2022.

cards.heading: Parkour, combat and the night
cards.text: Aiden crosses the city by climbing, sliding, wall-running and linking jumps between ledges. A grappling hook and paraglider extend those routes, while infection gives him further abilities. Fighting centres on melee weapons that wear down, with blueprints and salvaged components supporting improvements. The time of day changes which journey is safer. Zombies slow in sunlight and become more aggressive after dark, making rooftops useful alternatives to crowded streets. Their departure from interiors at night also opens places to search. Moving quickly is therefore tied to deciding when and where the next supplies can be reached.

cards.heading: Villedor and the choices that shape it
cards.text: The game is set in the city of Villedor, a massive urban open world set in Europe that players can explore freely. The map, which is four times bigger than the first game, is broken into seven distinct regions and each has its own landmarks and locations. When exploring the city, players can scavenge for scrap and resources to craft new items and weapons. Players can activate windmills to attract survivors and merchants to set up settlements. As the player explores the city, they will find inhibitors, which can be used to increase Aiden's health or stamina. Players meet different factions and have to make decisions that fundamentally change the state of the game's world and how non-playable characters view Aiden. The consequences are far-reaching, with the player being able to bring prosperity to a faction while completely destroying another settlement. Making certain decisions will open up or seal-off areas in the city, encouraging players to complete multiple playthroughs. Like its predecessor, the game features four-player cooperative multiplayer.

main.title: Sifu
main.summary: Sifu is a 2022 beat 'em up game developed and published by Sloclap.

cards.heading: A lifetime on a path of revenge
cards.text: Sifu is a 2022 beat 'em up game developed and published by Sloclap. Set in China, players control the child of a martial arts school's sifu (master) who seeks revenge on those responsible for their father's death. Every time the protagonist is killed, they are resurrected and age up, dealing more damage but reducing their maximum health. When the player character becomes too old, they can die permanently, in which case players must restart the level from the beginning and from the same age as their initial attempt.

cards.heading: Breaking a guard and mastering kung fu
cards.text: Sifu is an action beat 'em up game played from a third-person perspective. The game is inspired by Bak Mei kung fu and includes over 150 unique attacks. Basic attack moves can be chained together, though some combos may grant players additional tactical opportunities, such as being able to knock down enemies or stun them. The protagonist and hostile enemy characters have a "structural gauge". When the gauge is filled, the guard of these characters will break and they will become vulnerable to finishing attacks that heal the player more on their defeat. Players can block strikes, though this will gradually fill their gauge. Alternatively, players can evade attacks or parry when an enemy is about to land a blow. A successful parry allows the player to stun the enemy or throw them toward a particular direction.

cards.heading: Turning the environment into a weapon
cards.text: The game allows players to take advantage of the environment and improvise new attacks or alter their strategy when facing a stronger opponent. For instance, the player may kick an enemy off a ledge, or utilize various objects as makeshift weapons. Occasionally, an enemy in a level section may sometimes counter the player's finishing attack, becoming enraged and more powerful. Occasionally, the player may be presented with dialogue options, which can enable them to potentially avoid combat altogether depending on their choice of words.

cards.heading: Every defeat takes years
cards.text: When the player character dies, they are resurrected by a pendant at the spot where they die and age several years. As they age, their attacks will be more powerful, but they will have less health. Eventually, it will no longer be possible to revive due to the pendant breaking, and the next death will end the game. Players will encounter shrines, which allow them to heal and unlock skills. They can visit the "Wuguan", a Kung Fu school, to practice their skills in between levels. Temporarily unlocked abilities are lost after a game over, though it is possible to permanently unlock upgrades so that they are available at the beginning of each run. As the player completes multiple runs, they can access the "detective board", where the information collected across different runs will be stored, and secret areas and shortcuts may open up.

main.title: Horizon Forbidden West
main.subtitle: A More Vertical World for Aloy
main.summary: Horizon Forbidden West continued Aloy's journey in 2022 on both PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5.

cards.heading: Aloy travels west
cards.text: Horizon Forbidden West continued Aloy's journey in 2022 on both PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. Guerrilla expanded the ways she could cross the world: swimming, more climbing possibilities and new traversal tools let the landscape offer routes above and below the familiar paths.

cards.heading: Tools change the route
cards.text: The Pullcaster helps Aloy reach or move objects, while the Shieldwing turns a drop into a glide. These tools change what a cliff, opening or ruined structure can offer. The map becomes easier to read when the player begins looking for places where an acquired tool creates a different approach.

cards.heading: Let more people take the journey
cards.text: Guerrilla also documented options for subtitles, controls, difficulty and the amount of guidance shown onscreen. These choices affect how the same encounters can be read and played. Accessibility sits alongside the new machines and environments as part of the practical work of making a large adventure usable.

date_context_only.region: Original Steam Deck LCD commercial launch: first order emails February 25, 2022; first customer shipments began February 28, 2022. Not the later Steam Deck OLED.

main.title: Steam Deck
main.subtitle: A PC library in your hands
main.summary: Valve's portable computer connects a console-like form to the changing software world of the PC.

cards.heading: A PC library on the move
cards.text: Steam Deck brought the Steam library to a handheld PC running SteamOS. Its controls combine sticks, buttons, trackpads and a touch display, reflecting the many different interfaces PC games expect.

cards.heading: Compatibility as ongoing work
cards.text: Compatibility is ongoing work rather than a single hardware feature. The system shows how operating systems, translation tools and community knowledge help older and newer software move between environments. Portability can change not only where a game is played, but which parts of a library are revisited.

sources.title: Valve original launch announcement: February 25 order emails, February 28 first shipments
Proton collaborator first-person account of the Steam Deck launch and compatibility layer

features.title: The library travels with the machine

cards.heading: An idea waits for its battery
cards.text: Valve's 2022 Steam Deck book traces the idea back to work on the Steam Controller roughly a decade earlier. The team wanted demanding PC games in a handheld but did not yet have the necessary battery-sized hardware budget. Prototypes could explore the form while that constraint remained. Later, work with AMD on a custom processor brought the design closer to production. During the pandemic, colleagues shipped prototypes between one another to test ergonomics and control positions. The machine emerged through repeated handling as well as a component specification.

cards.heading: Earlier devices leave useful tools
cards.text: Steam Controller development supplied Steam Input, Steam Link contributed networking and streaming experience, and Steam Machines exposed compatibility problems involved in running Windows games on Linux. That work helped lead to Proton. These earlier projects provided parts of the software foundation needed to carry an existing PC library onto Deck.

cards.heading: A cursor needs more than touch
cards.text: Valve's launch-era developer questions make that variety concrete. A game built around a cursor may need hovering, different mouse buttons or precise movement, so a touchscreen alone is not always the right translation. The FAQ recommends considering the trackpads, and describes combining gyroscope aiming with a stick or pad. Developers can offer both conventional and motion configurations through Steam Input. The controls offer alternatives rather than one compulsory gesture. Bringing a PC game to the hand also means examining which assumptions its original interface made.

cards.heading: A retail machine can test a game
cards.text: Valve states that a retail Steam Deck can also serve as a development kit with the same tools and methods. Deck Verified checks controller support, legibility, performance and system compatibility. Its categories communicate how a particular game behaves on the handheld before the owner decides to install it.
